lines.en: I make my way over to the mall to hang out with Chika, but take a wrong turn somewhere and get stuck in an alternate reality instead.
lines.zh: 我本来要去商场跟 Chika 逛街，结果不知在哪儿拐错了弯，反倒被困在了一个平行现实里。

lines.en: A mysterious creature shows up and immediately scurries away as it may be the first time she’s seen a human being in hundreds of years.
lines.zh: 一只神秘的生物出现了，又立刻慌忙逃开——这大概是她几百年来头一次见到人类。

lines.en: She looks like someone I can’t remember, so I clap my hands to show her I’m not a threat and coax her into returning.
lines.zh: 她看上去像一个我想不起来的人，于是我拍了拍手，表示自己没有威胁，哄她回来。
: 你该不会是……

lines.en: : Looking for a good time? Sorry lady, but I’m {i}not that kind of guy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 想找点乐子？抱歉，女士，我{i}不是那种人{/i}。

lines.en: : No! U...Um...What I meant was...are you...by any chance...
lines.zh: : 不是！我……呃……我想问的是……你是……该不会是……
: 叫……Akira？……

lines.en: : How do you know my name, mysterious creature?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我的名字，神秘生物？

lines.en: : Oh my God! It really {i}is{/i} you, isn’t it?! It’s been so long!
lines.zh: : 我的天！真的{i}是{/i}你，对吧？！好久不见了！
: 抱歉，不过……我们以前见过吗？

lines.en: : Only once. You helped rip number 17 out of my mouth after my gums became infected and I’ve been searching for you to say thanks ever since.
lines.zh: : 只有一次。我的牙龈发炎之后，是你帮我把 17 号牙从嘴里拔出来的，从那以后我一直在找你，想跟你说声谢谢。

lines.en: : But, as you can see, I haven't really had any success until now.
lines.zh: : 不过你也看到了，直到现在都没什么进展。
: 天啊，真的好久好久了。
: 你有名字吗？
: 哦！对哦！我真傻。
: 我叫 Amy。

lines.en: : Do you...Do you come here often?
lines.zh: : 你……你常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m normally on the other side.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过我一般在另一边。
: 另一边？……

lines.en: : Do you mean the west wing?
lines.zh: : 你是说西侧翼？

lines.en: : No, I mean the side where the colors are brighter and there aren’t any character sprites.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说颜色更鲜艳、没有角色立绘的那一边。

lines.en: : I’m a little confused...but if you’re not familiar with the mall, I wouldn’t mind showing you around!
lines.zh: : 我有点糊涂了……不过如果你对商场不熟，我不介意带你逛逛！

lines.en: : No thanks. I’m just gonna head back to where I came from and go hang out with Chika instead. But it was nice seeing you and I’m glad to hear your gums are doing okay.
lines.zh: : 不用了。我打算回我来的地方，去找 Chika 玩。不过很高兴见到你，也很高兴听说你的牙龈没事了。
: 可是……你不能走。
: 为什么？

lines.en: : Because this is a special bonus mission. Nobody is allowed to leave until they’ve had enough fun at the mall. And even then, it's really difficult and there’s no reason to leave in the first place.
lines.zh: : 因为这是一个特别的隐藏任务。任何人在商场里玩够之前都不许离开。而且就算玩够了，要离开也非常困难，再说本来也没有离开的理由。

lines.en: : The world outside these walls is contaminated. Breathing in the air for longer than three minutes will fill your lungs with some weird stuff and then you’ll die.
lines.zh: : 这些墙外的世界已经被污染了。呼吸那里的空气超过三分钟，你的肺就会被某种奇怪的东西填满，然后你就会死。

lines.en: : So, all I have to do is have fun at the mall and I can leave?
lines.zh: : 那么，我只要在商场里玩得开心就能走了？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}technically{/i} yes. But...did you not just hear the part about how you’ll die?
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……{i}理论上{/i}是的。不过……你没听见刚才说你会死的那部分吗？

lines.en: : Don’t worry. If I die, everything will just start over. It’ll be totally fine.
lines.zh: : 别担心。如果我死了，一切就会从头再来。完全没问题的。

lines.en: : Then...in that case, maybe you and me could walk around for a little while?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然这样，也许你和我可以一起走走？
: 你是说像约会那样？

lines.en: : You’d really...consider going on a date with someone like me?...
lines.zh: : 你真的……愿意考虑跟我这样的人约会？……
: 你有性病吗？

lines.en: : Not any of the bad ones.
lines.zh: : 没有严重的那种。

lines.en: : Then sure. I don’t see any harm in that.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我觉得没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Plus, it’ll help me get acquainted with your side of the mall better. So if you have any tips or recommendations, please let me know.
lines.zh: : 而且这也能帮我更好地熟悉你这边的商场。所以如果你有什么建议或推荐，请一定告诉我。

lines.en: : I’m very excited to get going!
lines.zh: : 我已经迫不及待要出发了！

lines.en: : Me too! But, be warned — it’s really easy to get lost in there. So easy that even {i}I{/i} get lost sometimes, and I’ve been here for thousands of years!
lines.zh: : 我也是！不过先提醒你——在里面很容易迷路。容易到连{i}我{/i}有时候都会迷路，而我在这儿已经待了几千年了！

lines.en: : You look so young for someone in their thousands.
lines.zh: : 你都几千岁了，看着还这么年轻。

lines.en: : Teehee! You should have seen me when I still had hands.
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻！你要是见过我还有手的时候就好了。
: 来吧！我们开始吧！

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll be a load of fun!
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定一定会非常好玩！

lines.en: : Hey! Sorry about that. I slipped through a crack in reality and wound up somewhere in Halo 3. But I’m back now!
lines.zh: : 嘿！不好意思。我从一个现实裂缝里滑了出去，掉到了《光晕 3》里的什么地方。不过我回来了！

lines.en: : Great! Because I have absolutely no idea where we are.
lines.zh: : 太好了！因为我完全不知道我们在哪儿。

lines.en: : I already told you, silly! We’re at the mall.
lines.zh: : 我都说了呀，傻瓜！我们在商场里。

lines.en: : Before this, you were in the waiting room. That’s the room that you’re supposed to wait in before you’re admitted to the mall.
lines.zh: : 在这之前，你在等候室里。就是被允许进入商场之前该待着等的那个房间。

lines.en: : Sounds like a pretty serious mall if you need to wait just to get in.
lines.zh: : 光是进门都要等，听起来这商场挺正规的。

lines.en: : It’s the most serious mall! Everything you could ever want is here. It’s a little sad though since not many people know about it yet.
lines.zh: : 这是全世界最正规的商场！你想要的一切都在这儿。不过有点可惜，还没多少人知道它。

lines.en: : But I’m sure it will be swimming with customers in another year or two! You’ve gotta keep your hopes up, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过我敢肯定，再过一两年这里就会挤满顾客！人总要抱有希望嘛，你说是不是？
: 那么，我们从哪儿开始？
: 你想去哪儿都行！

lines.en: : It’d be no fun if I were to just take control of the date, you know? Gender roles dictate that the man is supposed to decide things like this and I’m just supposed to be good and listen to whatever he wants!
lines.zh: : 如果全程都由我来主导这场约会就没意思了，你知道吗？性别角色决定了这种事该由男人来决定，而我只要乖乖听他的就行！

lines.en: : I’m sure any decision you make will be fine! Like I said, everything you could ever want is here. And even if there’s {i}nothing{/i} you want, we have that too!
lines.zh: : 我相信你做什么决定都行！就像我说的，你想要的一切都在这儿。就算{i}没有什么{/i}你想要的，我们也有！

lines.en: : There’s a hole in the wall of the white room you can throw yourself into that will send you falling for the rest of eternity. That’s where my last boyfriend went, but I didn’t have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 白色房间的墙上有个洞，你把自己扔进去，就会永远往下掉。我上一个男朋友就是去那儿了，不过那事跟我没关系。

lines.en: : I promise I didn’t have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 我发誓那事跟我没关系。

lines.en: : I didn’t throw him into the hole.
lines.zh: : 我没有把他扔进洞里。
: 好吧，Amy。

lines.en: : Seriously, it wasn’t me. He did it himself.
lines.zh: : 真的，不是我。是他自己干的。

lines.en: : I didn’t put him in the hole.
lines.zh: : 我没有把他放进洞里。

lines.en: : A-Anyway! I’ll shut up about the hole now...
lines.zh: : 总——总之！我不再提那个洞了……

lines.en: : Just choose a direction and we’ll go from there!
lines.zh: : 你选个方向，我们就从那儿开始！
哦，天哪。

lines.en: I sure hope I don’t get lost.
lines.zh: 我真希望自己不会迷路。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Watch your feet, Akira. The foundation of this hall hasn't fully grown in yet and it’s caused the whole wing to get a little uneven.
lines.zh: : 小心脚下，Akira。这条走廊的地基还没完全长好，所以整个侧翼有点高低不平。

lines.en: : It’s kind of annoying to walk in sometimes, but I bet it would be really fun with a skateboard.
lines.zh: : 有时候走起来挺烦的，不过我敢打赌，踩着滑板一定会很好玩。

lines.en: : Do you have a skateboard, Amy?
lines.zh: : 你有滑板吗，Amy？

lines.en: : Me? I could never. I have a degenerative bone disease and my doctor says extreme sports aren’t good for me. But I do know of a shop here that sells them if you want to try!
lines.zh: : 我？我可不行。我有退化性骨病，医生说极限运动对我不好。不过如果你想试，我知道这儿有家店卖滑板！

lines.en: : Do you think I’d look cool as a...skateboard person?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我当个……玩滑板的人会看起来很酷吗？

lines.en: : Of course! I think you’ll look cool no matter what you do.
lines.zh: : 当然！我觉得你做什么都酷。

lines.en: : You've got a bit of a...cool {i}aura{/i} to you that's hard to describe.
lines.zh: : 你身上有一种……很难形容的{i}酷劲儿{/i}。

lines.en: : Like that feeling you get when you spin around really fast and start to see those white specks everywhere. Just, instead of white specks, it's like...I don't know. Cooler.
lines.zh: : 就像你飞快转圈、眼前开始冒出一片白点时的那种感觉。只不过不是白点，而是……我不知道。更酷的东西。

lines.en: : Well, for what it's worth, I think you're pretty cool too. Even {i}with{/i} your faulty bones.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎么说，我也觉得你挺酷的。{i}就算{/i}你的骨头有点毛病。

lines.en: : Aww...Thanks, Akira. That means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 啊……谢谢你，Akira。这对我意义重大。

lines.en: : I try to keep a positive attitude, but it's hard not getting down on myself sometimes when I look in the mirror, you know?
lines.zh: : 我努力保持积极的心态，可有时候照镜子，还是很难不自我否定，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Like, I'll think to myself...Amy! No one is ever going to love you and the world would be better off without you in it!
lines.zh: : 比如说，我会对自己说……Amy！永远不会有人爱你，没有你这个世界会更好！

lines.en: : Wow. That's extremely depressing and very likely untrue.
lines.zh: : 哇。这话说得太丧了，而且很可能不是真的。

lines.en: : Take me, for example. Without you, I'd be totally lost.
lines.zh: : 就拿我来说吧。没有你，我早就彻底迷路了。

lines.en: : Hahah! Thanks, Akira. It's the same for me whenever I'm not with you.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！谢谢你，Akira。我不在你身边的时候也是一样。
: 只是……有点不太一样。

lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Over here is where we gather to eat our meals and drink coffee and stuff!
lines.zh: : 这边是我们聚在一起吃饭、喝咖啡什么的的地方！

lines.en: : You can get all sorts of food in the mall, but my favorite is the garlic bread from Shiawase Group. I know it sounds boring, but they do this thing where-
lines.zh: : 商场里什么样的食物都有，不过我最喜欢的是 Shiawase Group 的蒜香面包。我知道听起来挺无聊的，但他们有一种做法——

lines.en: : I have no interest in bread, Amy.
lines.zh: : 我对面包没兴趣，Amy。

lines.en: : How come? Bread is good for you. The carbohydrates suck away the excess moisture in your intestines and make it so any living creature you accidentally ingest has a harder time moving around.
lines.zh: : 为什么？面包对身体好啊。碳水化合物会吸走你肠道里多余的水分，让你不小心吃进去的任何活物都更难活动。

lines.en: : Is that a thing you actively worry about?
lines.zh: : 你还真的会操心这种事啊？

lines.en: : Absolutely! If you’ve ever had a tapeworm, you’d understand.
lines.zh: : 当然！你要是得过绦虫，就会明白了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, there have been no recorded cases of anyone contracting tapeworms from Shiawase Group! Or {i}anywhere{/i} at the mall!
lines.zh: : 幸好，到目前为止还没有任何人因为 Shiawase Group 而感染绦虫的记录！商场里{i}任何地方{/i}都没有！

lines.en: : So if there’s somewhere you’d like to stop and grab a bite to eat, just let me know. We’ve got a lot more walking ahead of us after all.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你想在某个地方停下来吃点东西，尽管告诉我。毕竟我们接下来还要走很多路。

lines.en: : You’re going to need all the energy you can get.
lines.zh: : 你需要尽可能多的体力。

lines.en: : Oh! I know exactly where we are! Even more so than normal!
lines.zh: : 哦！我完全知道我们在哪儿了！比平时还清楚！

lines.en: : Is this what they call a “power spot?”
lines.zh: : 这就是所谓的“能量景点”吗？

lines.en: : What? No. What even is that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那是什么东西？

lines.en: : What I was going to say is that I used to ride that little helicopter thingy over there when I was little.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，我小时候经常坐那边那个小小的直升机设施。

lines.en: : It plays this song my mom used to sing to me. It’s called, like...Daisy Bell, I think? Or Bicycle Built For Two? I don’t know. It’s one of those.
lines.zh: : 它会放一首我妈妈以前常唱给我听的歌。好像叫……《Daisy Bell》？还是《Bicycle Built For Two》？我不知道。反正就是那一类的。

lines.en: : Wow, this brings back so many memories.
lines.zh: : 哇，这勾起了好多回忆。

lines.en: : Are you still in touch with your mom?
lines.zh: : 你还跟妈妈有联系吗？

lines.en: : I am! We meet up on Wednesdays to go water the plants and have our retinal fluid refilled over in the medical ward.
lines.zh: : 有啊！我们每周三见面，去给植物浇水，然后到医疗区把视网膜液重新注满。

lines.en: : My vision is fine, but hers is starting to get a little worse as the years go by. So I still get the shots myself so she doesn’t have to feel bad about going blind.
lines.zh: : 我的视力没问题，但她的视力随着年岁增长开始有点衰退了。所以我也照样去打针，这样她就不用因为自己快瞎了而难过。
: 你真是个好女儿。

lines.en: : Oh, stop! You’re gonna make me blush...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了！你要让我脸红了……
: 嘿……Akira？

lines.en: : Do you really not remember the first time we met?
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得我们第一次见面的事了吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but...no. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过……不。我真的不记得了。
: 这样啊……
: 你还好吗？
: 嗯——嗯！我只是……

lines.en: : It’s nothing. Don’t even worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没什么。别放在心上。

lines.en: : Guh. This part of the mall always creeps me out.
lines.zh: : 呃。商场这一块总是让我发毛。
: 为什么这么暗？

lines.en: : Rumor has it that a long time ago, when the mall was first coming into existence, a small group of some...weird kind of entity or something snuck in and started nesting around here.
lines.zh: : 传闻说很久以前，商场刚形成的时候，有一小群……某种奇怪的实体还是什么东西溜了进来，在这附近筑了巢。

lines.en: : I think I heard a thing about how they’d burrow into the ground and then pull the tiles back over the holes they dug to make it look like everything is normal.
lines.zh: : 我好像听说过，它们会钻进地里，再把地砖重新盖回自己挖的洞上，好让一切看起来很正常。

lines.en: : It reminds me a lot of some story my dad read to me when I was little. About these weird monster thingies retreating into the earth to suck up energy from the soil.
lines.zh: : 这让我想起爸爸小时候给我读的一个故事。讲的是一些奇怪的小怪物退回到地里，吸食土壤里的能量。

lines.en: : I also heard that if they suck up enough, they can manipulate their bodies into appearing human! Meaning some of them could be here right now and we’d have no idea!
lines.zh: : 我还听说，如果它们吸得够多，就能把自己的身体变成人类的样子！也就是说，它们中间有些可能现在就在我们身边，而我们完全不知道！

lines.en: : I’m having second thoughts about exploring this part of the mall now.
lines.zh: : 我现在开始重新考虑要不要逛商场这一块了。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll be okay. We have each other, after all!
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定不会有事的。毕竟我们有彼此！
: 而且……
: 我觉得……

lines.en: : I feel really safe when I’m with you...
lines.zh: : 和你在一起的时候，我觉得特别安心……

lines.en: : How would I even get in there? I’m not nearly tall enough and my jumping skills are subpar at best.
lines.zh: : 我怎么进去啊？我根本不够高，跳跃能力最多也只能算一般。

lines.en: : I can give you a boost! I’m stronger than I look, you know.
lines.zh: : 我可以托你一把！我可比看起来壮，你知道吗。

lines.en: : How about I just give {i}you{/i} a boost instead?
lines.zh: : 不如换成我托{i}你{/i}一把？

lines.en: : So you can peek up my skirt? No way, Jose. That’s third date territory right there.
lines.zh: : 好让你偷看我的裙子？想得美。那可是第三次约会才能干的事。

lines.en: : I feel like we’ve been here long enough at this point to count it as multiple dates.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们待了这么久，已经够算好几次约会了。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! You haven’t seen anything yet!
lines.zh: : 才没有！你还没见识过什么呢！

lines.en: : Actually, come to think of it, we’re not far from the official mall mascot’s cage.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我们离商场官方吉祥物的笼子不远了。
: 商场还有官方吉祥物？

lines.en: : Yup! It’s a naked homeless man who showed up here on accident one day.
lines.zh: : 对啊！是个裸体的流浪汉，有一天不小心闯进来的。

lines.en: : He kept screaming about wanting to get out, but mall policy dictates that all complaints must be sent directly to the main office, so he was tied up and thrown into a cage.
lines.zh: : 他一直大叫着想出去，可商场规定所有投诉都必须直接提交给总办公室，于是他就被绑起来扔进了笼子。
: 听起来不太合法啊。

lines.en: : The craziest part of all of it is that his face has been slowly disappearing day by day. All that’s left now is his right nostril and a tiny skin-gap where his mouth used to be.
lines.zh: : 最离谱的是，他的脸一天天慢慢消失了。现在只剩下右鼻孔，还有原来嘴巴位置上的一条小缝。
: 那他怎么吃东西呢？

lines.en: : I don’t think I want to see the homeless man.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不想去看那个流浪汉。

lines.en: : Are you sure? I have a handful of pennies we can throw at him to make him do a dance.
lines.zh: : 确定吗？我手里有一把硬币，可以扔他让他跳个舞。
: 不用了，Ami。
: 是 Amy。
: 我叫 {i}Amy{/i}。
: 这里没有 Ami。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。
: Amy？你还好吗？
: 嗯！我只是……

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel a little embarrassed around you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我在你身边总忍不住有点难为情。就这样。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to be embarrassed about. I’m the same as you — made of meat and full of blood.
lines.zh: : 没什么好难为情的。我和你一样——都是肉做的，里面装满了血。

lines.en: : I know, I know...But you’re just so cool.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……可你就是很酷。

lines.en: : I’ve always wanted to go on a date with somebody like you. And being able to walk around my favorite place in the world with you like this is...
lines.zh: : 我一直想和你这样的人约会。而能和你一起在我最喜欢的地方这样走着……
: 这让我非常幸福。

lines.en: : So happy that the tiny hairs on my arms are starting to stand up and cut through this shirt I got from the H&M in the north wing.
lines.zh: : 幸福到我胳膊上的汗毛都竖了起来，快要把这件在北翼 H&M 买的衬衫戳破了。

lines.en: : So happy that, for the first time in thousands of years, I can feel things...{i}happening{/i} to me that haven’t happened in...
lines.zh: : 幸福到几千年来第一次，我能感觉到有些事情……{i}正在发生{/i}在我身上，而那些事已经……有……

lines.en: : Well, a really long time. And I just don’t want this day to ever come to an end.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很久很久没有过了。我只是不想让这一天结束。

lines.en: : Well, at this rate, you might be in luck. I have no idea where I’m going and feel like I’ve been in here forever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，照这个速度，你也许走运了。我完全不知道自己在往哪儿走，感觉像是已经在这里待了一辈子。

lines.en: : The saddest part is that, for me...it only feels like it’s been a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 最让人难过的是，对我来说……只像过了几分钟。
: 留下来吧，Akira。
: 我们在这里可以幸福的。

lines.en: : If nowhere else will let that happen for us, why not take a chance and...start over {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果别的地方都不肯让我们幸福，为什么不赌一把……{i}就在这里{/i}重新开始呢？

lines.en: : Why not stay in this mall with me for the rest of forever?
lines.zh: : 为什么不永远留在这个商场里陪我呢？
: 我不能，Ami。
: 是 {i}Amy{/i}。而且你{i}能{/i}。
: 只要存个档就行。

lines.en: : Save the game and stay here so the world will stop moving and we can be together forever.
lines.zh: : 存个档然后留下来，这样世界就会停止运转，我们就能永远在一起了。

lines.en: : I know that we’ve only just met, but I feel like I’ve known you forever and...and I can’t let this chance get away!
lines.zh: : 我知道我们才刚认识，可我觉得像是早就认识你很久了，而且……而且我不能让这个机会溜走！

lines.en: : Save the game, Akira! Save the game and come visit me every single night! I’ll look forward to it! I’ll never stop looking forward to it!
lines.zh: : 存个档吧，Akira！存个档，然后每天晚上都来看我！我会盼着你的！我会一直一直盼下去的！

lines.en: : And if we run out of things to say, I’ll...I’ll think up new ones! I’ll keep adding new places for us to explore and things to talk about because I...
lines.zh: : 如果有一天我们没话说了，我就……我就想新的！我会不断为我们增加新的地方去探索、新的话题可以聊，因为我……
: 我爱你。
: 而我终于幸福了。
: 我会永远在这里。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。
: 我们现在在哪儿？

lines.en: : Hmm...I think this is the entrance to the subway.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想这是地铁的入口。
: 我知道赛百味。新鲜每一天。

lines.en: : Not {i}that{/i} Subway, silly. I mean an actual subway. You know, like with trains and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}那个{/i}赛百味啦，傻瓜。我说的是真的地铁。你知道的，有火车什么的那种。

lines.en: : In the mall? Why is there a subway in the mall?
lines.zh: : 在商场里？商场里为什么会有地铁？

lines.en: : This isn’t just any mall! It’s the greatest mall in the world! Like, if what I’ve heard is correct, it’s even bigger than the state of Rhode Island. And I’m pretty sure that’s kind of impressive.
lines.zh: : 这可不是普通的商场！这是全世界最棒的商场！如果我没听错的话，它比罗德岛州还大。我敢说这还挺了不起的。

lines.en: : Having a subway to move between different wings is essential to all of the people who live here since most of the housing is over in the south wing.
lines.zh: : 对住在这里的人来说，有一条能在各个侧翼之间往返的地铁是必需的，因为大部分住宅都在南翼。

lines.en: : Personally, I don’t have much use for it since I enjoy walking through the mall so much. And everybody here knows me, so nobody will get mad if I take a nap on a bench or something.
lines.zh: : 我个人倒是很少用，因为我太喜欢在商场里走路了。而且这里的人都认识我，所以就算我在长椅上睡一觉什么的，也没人会生气。

lines.en: : You really love this mall, huh?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢这个商场啊？

lines.en: : It’s the only place where I’ve ever felt like I belong.
lines.zh: : 这是唯一一个让我觉得自己有归属感的地方。

lines.en: : Before I came here, the world I was stuck in was so...
lines.zh: : 在我来这儿之前，我困在的那个世界是那样的……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say I didn’t really fit in with anybody. And my idea of what a happy life should be was way different from what anyone {i}else{/i} thought.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只能说我和谁都合不来。而我对幸福生活该是什么样的想法，也跟{i}别人{/i}想的差了十万八千里。

lines.en: : I’m glad things ended up like this, though. Because even if most of my memories from those days are gone, the ones that are still kinda stuck in my head help me realize that...
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴事情变成了这样。因为即使那些日子的记忆大多都消失了，还残留在脑子里的那些却让我明白……

lines.en: : Well, something like this is what’s best for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，像这样的生活才是最适合我的。

lines.en: : And having you here only makes that better.
lines.zh: : 而你在身边，只会让这一切变得更好。

lines.en: : A-Anyway! Sorry for saying all that embarrassing stuff. We can...
lines.zh: : 总——总之！抱歉说了那么多难为情的话。我们可以……

lines.en: : We can go now. There’s not much else over here.
lines.zh: : 我们可以走了。这边没什么别的了。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Shh...You have to be really quiet over here.
lines.zh: : 嘘……在这边你必须非常安静。
: 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...you don’t {i}have{/i} to, technically. I just have some reeeeeeaaaaally overdue VHS tapes from the rental store over there and I don’t want them to see me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……严格来说你{i}不用{/i}。只是我在那边那家租赁店借的录像带逾期超————级久了，我不想让他们看见我。
: 为什么不直接还回去？

lines.en: : Obviously because I’m still using them. Do you have any idea how hard it is to get a copy of “Endless White Noise” nowadays? If I return {i}my{/i} copy and it ends up in the wrong hands?...Ugh. Don’t even.
lines.zh: : 当然是因为我还在用啊。你知道现在搞到一盘《无尽白噪声》有多难吗？如果{i}我{/i}把这盘还回去，结果落到别人手里？……呃。别提了。
: 《无尽白噪声》是什么？

lines.en: : It’s a tape of endless white noise. It helps me fall asleep and makes my stomach stop hurting whenever it gets upset.
lines.zh: : 就是一盘无限白噪声的录像带。它能帮我入睡，还能在我胃不舒服的时候让它不疼。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not {i}endless,{/i} right? If it’s on a VHS tape, it would need to be, like...rewound and stuff.
lines.zh: : 可它也做不到{i}无限{/i}吧？既然是录像带，那总得……倒带什么的。

lines.en: : You’d think so, but this tape is special.
lines.zh: : 你这么想也正常，不过这盘带子很特别。

lines.en: : The film is made from the stomach lining of a beluga whale. And the guy at the store told me that it’s the whale's memories that are making the noise and not any actual, like...filmmaking or whatever.
lines.zh: : 它的胶片是用白鲸的胃黏膜做的。店里的那个人告诉我，发出噪声的是那头鲸鱼的记忆，而不是什么真正的……拍电影之类的。

lines.en: : Why would a whale’s memories be stored in its stomach?
lines.zh: : 鲸鱼的记忆为什么会存在它的胃里？

lines.en: : Because whales consume the memories of all the fish they swallow.
lines.zh: : 因为鲸鱼会吞下所有被它吃掉的鱼的记忆。
: 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. You didn’t know that? There’s a library around the corner if you want to research it. I just can’t go in there either since I have a few overdue picture books.
lines.zh: : 对啊。你不知道吗？拐角处有个图书馆，你想研究可以去查。只是我也进不去，因为我还有几本绘本逾期了。

lines.en: : Do you just not understand the concept of renting or something?
lines.zh: : 你是完全不懂“租借”这个概念还是怎么的？
: 嘻嘻！好像是呢！

lines.en: : Watch your step. If you cut your feet on broken glass, they could get infected. Then, you’ll have to go all the way over to the medical ward. And they pretty much always have really long lines.
lines.zh: : 小心脚下。如果被碎玻璃划伤了脚，可能会感染。那样你就得一路跑到医疗区去，而那里几乎总是排着长队。

lines.en: : Thanks for looking out for me, Amy. I don’t know how to do that thing you’re doing, though. So I’ll just stand still for now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你照顾我，Amy。不过我不会你正在做的那个动作。所以我先站着不动好了。

lines.en: : Hahah! I was like that once upon a time as well.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我以前也是那样的。

lines.en: : Wall-walking is a skill only those who fully devote themselves to the mall can learn.
lines.zh: : 走墙是只有完全献身于商场的人才能学会的技能。

lines.en: : Well, I’m very impressed by your unwavering devotion.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这份毫不动摇的虔诚让我非常佩服。
: 谢谢！

lines.en: : You know, you should devote yourself to the mall as well, Akira. There really aren’t any downsides to it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你也该把自己献给商场，Akira。这真的没有任何坏处。

lines.en: : Plus, if there’s something in particular you’re looking for, it’ll only be a hop, skip, and a jump away!
lines.zh: : 而且如果你想找什么东西，也就是一蹦一跳的工夫！

lines.en: : That sounds nice and all, I’m just not sure if this place is for me just yet.
lines.zh: : 听起来是不错，只是我还不确定这地方适不适合我。

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, what do you think would make it better?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你觉得怎么做才会更好？

lines.en: : If all my friends were here...
lines.zh: : 如果我所有的朋友都在这儿……

lines.en: : Yeah...I can see how not being able to communicate with the people you love could be a real bummer.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我能理解，没办法和你爱的人交流确实挺扫兴的。

lines.en: : But, on the bright side, you have me! And I won’t leave your side {i}at all{/i} while you’re here!
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，你还有我！你在这儿的时候，我{i}一步都{/i}不会离开你身边！

lines.en: : Not even when I go to the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 连我上厕所的时候也不离开？

lines.en: : Not even when you go to the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 连你上厕所的时候也不离开。

lines.en: : But it’s for your own good. Because I don’t want you getting lost and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过这也是为你好。因为我不想让你迷路什么的。

lines.en: : You’re lying to me, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在骗我，对吧？

lines.en: : I might be lying to you.
lines.zh: : 也许是在骗你。

: Taco Bell。
: 哦，好吧。

lines.en: : Oh man. I’m so excited. I heard that if you eat enough tacos, they’ll let you ring the bell. And if you ring it loud enough, you’ll wake up the giant frog in the center of the mall!
lines.zh: : 天哪。我好兴奋。我听说如果你吃的塔可够多，他们就会让你敲那口钟。而如果你敲得够响，就会吵醒商场中央那只巨大的青蛙！
: 什么？

lines.en: : The giant frog in the center of the mall. Do they not have one where you come from?
lines.zh: : 商场中央那只巨大的青蛙。你们那儿没有吗？

lines.en: : Well, I guess that probably sounds pretty worrying then, huh?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那听起来大概挺让人担心的吧？

lines.en: : There’s nothing to fear, though. He’s harmless. And even when he wakes up, he kind of just looks around for a little while before spitting out an egg and then going back to sleep.
lines.zh: : 不过没什么好怕的。他没有恶意。就算醒了，他也只是四下看看，吐出一颗卵，然后又睡回去。

lines.en: : You know, just normal frog stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是青蛙的正常操作啦。

lines.en: : I suddenly don’t think I’m in the mood for tacos anymore.
lines.zh: : 我突然不太想吃塔可了。

lines.en: : Don’t be such a baby, Sensei! You’ll be fine!

lines.en: : C-Can you just sit down already so we can eat our tacos?!
lines.zh: : 你——你能不能赶紧坐下，我们把塔可吃了？！

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.

lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。
: Akira，Akira！我们来玩吧！

lines.en: : I think we’re a little too old to play in that weird rectangle, Amy.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们年纪太大了，不适合在那个奇怪的长方形里玩，Amy。

lines.en: : You’re never too old for rectangles! That’s what my mom always says.
lines.zh: : 玩长方形永远不会嫌老！我妈妈总这么说。

lines.en: : Wow, your mom sounds like a real {i}square.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哇，你妈妈听起来真是个{i}老古板{/i}。

lines.en: : Come on! Over here! We can do stuff on this...bridge thingy!
lines.zh: : 来嘛！到这边来！我们可以在这个……桥一样的东西上面玩！

lines.en: : What kind of {i}stuff{/i} can we possibly do on that “bridge thingy?” It can barely even fit you and you’re only half my size.
lines.zh: : 在那个“桥一样的东西”上能玩{i}什么{/i}？它连你都快装不下，而你才只有我一半大。

lines.en: : We can pretend we’re hermit crabs on the hunt for new shells! Or sing the hot dog song together!
lines.zh: : 我们可以假装自己是寄居蟹，在找新壳！或者一起唱热狗歌！

lines.en: : What is the hot dog song?
lines.zh: : 热狗歌是什么？

lines.en: : {i}Hot dogs, not dogs ~ not made of dogs! Piping ~ hot and ~  not made of dogs!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}热狗不是狗 ~ 不是狗做的！滚烫 ~ 热乎 ~ 不是狗做的！{/i}

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, the insistence that they’re not made of dogs is making me very suspicious.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这么执着地强调“不是狗做的”让我非常可疑。

lines.en: : Just come over and play with me already!
lines.zh: : 你快点过来陪我玩嘛！

lines.en: : No. In fact, I think you should come down before you get hurt. You’re going to fall.
lines.zh: : 不。而且我觉得你该下来了，免得受伤。你会掉下来的。

lines.en: : I’m not going to fall! I do this all the time!
lines.zh: : 我不会掉下来的！我经常这么玩！

lines.en: : Amy, I am {i}telling{/i} you — you are going to fall.
lines.zh: : Amy，我跟你{i}说了{/i}——你会掉下来的。

lines.en: : Lies and slander! Just look at how nimble I am!
lines.zh: : 污蔑！诽谤！你看我多灵活！
: 哎哟。
: 我掉下来了。

lines.en: : This is what you get for trying to play without legs.
lines.zh: : 这就是没有腿还想玩的代价。

lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Hey, Akira...what kind of girls do you like?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Akira……你喜欢什么样的女孩子？

lines.en: : Is that even something you’re supposed to be asking on a date?
lines.zh: : 这问题是在约会时该问的吗？

lines.en: : Sure! I need to know which ones to avoid and when I should grab your arm and run in the opposite direction.
lines.zh: : 当然！我得知道该躲开哪些人，还有什么时候该抓起你的胳膊往反方向跑。

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound a lot like some other girl I know.
lines.zh: : 你说话的口气开始有点像我认识的另一个女孩了。
: 哦是吗？{i}她{/i}是你喜欢的类型吗？
: 她……绝对算是{i}一种{/i}类型。
: {i}一种{/i}类型？那是什么意思？
: 只是说她非常独特。

lines.en: : Well, uniqueness is a great quality in a girl! It’s great in guys too! And a huge part of why I like you so much!
lines.zh: : 嗯，独特是女孩子很棒的品质！男孩子也是！这也是我这么喜欢你的重要原因！

lines.en: : What makes me so different from everyone else you know?
lines.zh: : 我跟你认识的其他人有什么不一样？

lines.en: : Well, to begin with, all of the people here are invisible from behind.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，这里所有人的背面都是看不见的。
: 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. You can only see us head-on since that’s all that was designed.
lines.zh: : 对啊。你只能从正面看到我们，因为当初只设计了正面。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how it is where you’re from, but that’s just par for the course here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你那边是什么样，但在这里这就是常态。

lines.en: : That makes certain...{i}positions{/i} sound actively unfun.
lines.zh: : 那某些……{i}姿势{/i}听起来就一点都不好玩了。

lines.en: : Ewwww, gross! Don’t be such a perv while we’re in the east wing! That’s what the north side is for.
lines.zh: : 咦————好恶心！我们在东侧翼，别这么色！那是北侧才该干的事。

lines.en: : What’s this side for then? What’s there to do where we are now?
lines.zh: : 那这边是干什么的？我们现在这儿有什么好玩的？

lines.en: : Luxury shopping mostly. If you’re in the market for a Rolex or something like that, you can head over to the left. And the Tesla shop is over to the right, but that’s full of hipsters and it makes me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 主要是奢侈品购物。如果你想买劳力士之类的，可以往左边走。特斯拉店在右边，不过里面全是潮人，让我觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : And what if I’m not in the market for either?
lines.zh: : 那要是我两样都不想买呢？

lines.en: : Then you have no other choice but to simply enjoy your time with me!
lines.zh: : 那你就别无选择，只能好好享受和我待在一起的时光！

lines.en: : Ooooooh, I wonder what’s over there.
lines.zh: : 哦————哦，不知道那边有什么。
: 嘿！Akira！快回来！

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : It’s not an echo if you just keep yelling “echo” you know.
lines.zh: : 你一直喊“回声”可不算回声啊，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I know...I just always expect the acoustics to be a little better in here with how empty this part of the mall is.
lines.zh: : 我知道……只是这一带商场这么空，我总以为回声效果会好一点。
: 还有……这到底是什么地方？

lines.en: : This is how you get to the parking garage. And it’s obviously empty since nobody is able to leave and there’s no reason to {i}go{/i} to the garage.
lines.zh: : 这是去停车场的路。显然很空，因为谁都走不了，也就没有理由{i}去{/i}停车场。

lines.en: : Doesn’t the existence of parking garages imply people {i}were{/i} able to leave at some point, though?
lines.zh: : 可既然有停车场，不就说明以前的人{i}是可以{/i}离开的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, because they were. It was only after the air became contaminated that we were forced to keep ourselves in here. But this mall was made with the possibility of that in mind to begin with.
lines.zh: : 是的，因为他们以前确实能走。只是在空气被污染之后，我们才被迫关在这里。不过这个商场从一开始就是考虑到这种可能性而建的呢。

lines.en: : The people who built the mall knew something like that would happen?
lines.zh: : 建商场的人就知道会发生这种事？

lines.en: : Yes! But you’re wrong about one thing — it wasn’t people who built the mall. It was the mall itself.
lines.zh: : 是的！不过有一点你说错了——建这个商场的不是人。是商场自己。
: 什么？

lines.en: : Mhm! Crazy, right? This mall is technically a living thing. It’s still growing and expanding and sucking in people like you who aren’t {i}supposed{/i} to be here, but {i}want{/i} to be here.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！很疯狂吧？严格来说，这个商场是一个活物。它还在生长、扩张，并且把像你这样本不{i}该{/i}在这里、却{i}想{/i}在这里的人吸进来。

lines.en: : All of us are simply living inside of it. And for that, we must pay our thanks as we wander through what would probably be its organs! Kinda gross when you think about it like that though, huh?
lines.zh: : 我们所有人都只是住在它里面。为此，我们得一边穿过大概算是它器官的地方，一边心怀感激！不过这么一想还挺恶心的，对吧？
: 有一点，嗯……

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? Are you finally ready to go to Toys “R” Us?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？你终于准备好去玩具反斗城了？

lines.en: : No. I just made a wrong turn.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是拐错了弯。
: 呃。可恶。

lines.en: : What? What’s wrong? Why are you yelling?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？出什么事了？你为什么在叫？
: 你看，Akira！是玩具反斗城！

lines.en: : I thought they were all gone!
lines.zh: : 我还以为它们全倒闭了呢！

lines.en: : Why do they put the “R” in quotation marks? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 他们为什么把“R”放进引号里？我不懂。

lines.en: : They also put it backwards, but...is that really what you’re concerned about? You should be freaking out just as much as me right now! We might have stumbled upon something amazing!
lines.zh: : 他们还把 R 反过来了，可是……你真的在意这个吗？你现在该跟我一样激动才对！我们可能发现了什么了不起的东西！

lines.en: : You really didn’t know it was here? I thought you knew this place like the back of your hand.
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道这里有？我以为你对这地方了如指掌呢。

lines.en: : I don’t have hands. We already went over this.
lines.zh: : 我没有手。我们不是说过了吗。
: 哦，对。抱歉。

lines.en: : Hahah! It’s fine, don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！没关系，别放在心上。

lines.en: : And yes, I do know this place very well. But that doesn’t mean there aren’t still new things popping up every now and then! So whenever I find a place I haven’t seen before, I can’t help but get excited.
lines.zh: : 而且没错，我确实对这地方很熟。可这不代表不会有新东西时不时冒出来！所以每次我发现一个没见过的地方，都会忍不住激动。

lines.en: : I know what you mean. My town is a little like that too.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思。我住的小镇也有点像这样。
: 真的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m not sure if we have one of...whatever this place is, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我不确定我们那儿有没有一个……不管这到底是什么的地方。

lines.en: : How about I {i}show{/i} you what it is?!
lines.zh: : 要不我带你{i}看看{/i}它是什么？！

lines.en: : Come on, Akira! Let’s go play!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Akira！我们去玩！

lines.en: : Maybe a little later, Amy. I still want to look around.
lines.zh: : 也许待会儿吧，Amy。我还想再逛逛。

lines.en: : Grr...fine. But you’re definitely taking me soon, okay?
lines.zh: : 唔……好吧。不过你一定要早点带我去，好吗？

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Jesus. Why would you do that?
lines.zh: : 天啊。你干嘛要这样？

lines.en: : Hahahahah! You should have seen the look on your face!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！你该看看你刚才的表情！

lines.en: : Do you scare all of your dates? Or just me?
lines.zh: : 你每次约会都吓人吗？还是只吓我？

lines.en: : You make it sound like I go on a lot of dates when that’s not the case at all.
lines.zh: : 听你的口气，好像我经常约会似的，其实根本没有。

lines.en: : This is actually the first one I’ve been on since you ripped number 17 out of my mouth.
lines.zh: : 事实上，这是你从我嘴里拔掉 17 号牙之后，我第一次约会。
: 真的吗？

lines.en: : Mhm! I’ve been so focused on finding you that I kind of lost interest in dating altogether. It’s not a big deal, though. It’s not like I’m totally alone here or anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！我太专心找你了，所以对约会这件事整体上失去了兴趣。不过也没什么大不了的。我又不是在这里孤零零一个人什么的。
: 你有朋友吗？

lines.en: : I used to. Now, my only real companions are a group of pigeons that gather near the food court looking for scraps. I think they’re starting to believe I’m one of them.
lines.zh: : 以前有。现在我真正的伙伴只剩下一群聚集在美食广场附近捡剩饭的鸽子。我觉得它们开始把我当成同类了。

lines.en: : Do I give off pigeon vibes, Akira? Because I didn’t think I did, but it’s hard to ever really tell what you’re looking at when you glance into the mirror. It’s better to rely on others for that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我看起来有鸽子的气质吗，Akira？我自己觉得没有，可你往镜子里瞥一眼，其实很难看清自己到底是什么样。这种事还是靠别人比较好。

lines.en: : You give off normal girl vibes to me. But I’m not very experienced when it comes to vibes, so take that with a grain of salt.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，你就是普通女孩子的气质。不过我对气质这回事不太在行，所以你随便听听就好。

lines.en: : Hahah! Will do. You wanna know what kind of vibes {i}you{/i} give off, though?
lines.zh: : 哈哈！好的。不过你想知道{i}你{/i}给人什么气质吗？
: 当然。说吧。
: {i}爸爸{/i}的气质。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that’s an insult or a compliment.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这是骂人还是夸人。
: 嗯……都有！
: 我喜欢和你在一起。

lines.en: : I’m not really...{i}opposed{/i} to this leading to something more one day...
lines.zh: : 我其实……{i}不反对{/i}有一天我们能更进一步……

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Why’d you wanna come down here? All the fun stuff is back upstairs.
lines.zh: : 你为什么想下来这儿？好玩的东西都在楼上。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to. It just kind of happened on account of me having literally no idea where I am.
lines.zh: : 我不是故意的。就是因为我真的完全不知道自己在哪儿，所以就走到这儿了。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} say we head back upstairs because we’re not supposed to be in here. Plus, it creeps me the heck out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}建议我们回楼上去，因为我们不该在这儿。而且这地方让我毛骨悚然。

lines.en: : Like, you know that weird feeling you get in your stomach when you go somewhere you’re not supposed to be? That’s pretty much all I feel right now.
lines.zh: : 就是那种……你去了不该去的地方时，肚子里冒出的奇怪感觉？我现在基本上就只有这种感觉了。

lines.en: : And it’s definitely not because I’m hiding what’s in here from you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 而且绝对不是因为我在瞒着你这里面有什么。明白吗？

lines.en: : Got it. But what is this place? The...basement or something?
lines.zh: : 明白。不过这地方是什么？……地下室之类的？

lines.en: : It’s nothing! Don’t worry about it!
lines.zh: : 没什么！别管了！
: Amy——
: 我上楼去了！拜拜！

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Wow...it’s so colorful in here. I wonder if it’s like a daycare or something?
lines.zh: : 哇……这里面颜色好鲜艳。我在想这是不是像托儿所之类的？

lines.en: : Did you ever have to go to daycare, Amy?
lines.zh: : 你小时候上过托儿所吗，Amy？
: 嗯……我记不太清了。

lines.en: : Some weird stuff happened to my memories before I wound up in the mall, so there’s a lot of just, uhh...I guess you could call it blank space in there?
lines.zh: : 在我来到商场之前，我的记忆发生过一些奇怪的事，所以里面有很多，呃……大概可以叫空白的地方？

lines.en: : Basically, it feels like everything is only half complete. And there’s stuff that makes me {i}feel{/i} like I’m remembering sometimes-
lines.zh: : 基本上，感觉一切都只完成了一半。有时候会有一些东西让我{i}觉得{/i}自己在回忆起什么——

lines.en: : But then something fun or interesting or dramatic happens and I just go back to being complacently oblivious!
lines.zh: : 可接着就会发生什么有趣的、好玩的或者戏剧性的事，然后我又回到那种心安理得的一无所知里去了！

lines.en: : I know how you feel. Just without the “complacent” part, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的感觉。大概只是没有“心安理得”那部分吧。

lines.en: : Are you not happy with where you’re from, Akira? Because if not, you should just stay here with me! I’m very happy! Just imagine how happy I’d be with {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你对自己来的地方不满意吗，Akira？如果不满意，你就留在这儿陪我好了！我很幸福！想想看，有{i}你{/i}在我会多幸福！

lines.en: : It’s not that I’m unhappy. It’s more that I’m just...nothing.
lines.zh: : 不是不幸福。更多的是我只是……什么都不是。

lines.en: : Well you’re something to {i}me,{/i} Akira. And even if the rest of the world stops caring about you, {i}that{/i} won’t change.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对{i}我{/i}来说你就是什么，Akira。就算全世界都不再在乎你，{i}这一点{/i}也不会变。

lines.en: : What I’ve learned through my time here is that life is what you make of it — so it’s best to make it fun!
lines.zh: : 我在这里学到的道理是，生活是你自己造就的——所以最好把它变得有趣！

lines.en: : Whether that means indulging in your hobbies or interests...or even just teaching yourself not to care what other people say about you! There’s always {i}something{/i} you can do!
lines.zh: : 不管是沉浸在自己的爱好和兴趣里……还是干脆学会不去在意别人怎么说你！总有你{i}能做的事{/i}！

lines.en: : Thanks, Amy. That means a lot.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Amy。这对我意义重大。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. A bit of helpful advice is the least I can do after all you’ve done for me.
lines.zh: : 别客气。你为我做了那么多，我至少也能给你一点有用的建议。

lines.en: : Are you talking about your teeth again?
lines.zh: : 你又在说牙齿的事了吗？
: 不是。
: 那是什么——

lines.en: : Come on! Let’s see what we can find next!
lines.zh: : 走吧！看看我们接下来能发现什么！

: Akira？

lines.en: : I think I’ve seen enough, Amy.
lines.zh: : 我想我看得够多了，Amy。
: 够多了？……

lines.en: : No! No, you’ve barely seen anything! We still have lots left to explore!
lines.zh: : 不！不，你几乎什么都没看到！我们还有好多地方没探索呢！

lines.en: : You...You can’t leave yet! You can’t leave at all! You haven’t had enough fun! You have to stay until you’ve done everything there is to do! You need to have more fun!
lines.zh: : 你……你还不能走！你根本不能走！你还没有玩够！你必须留下来，直到把这里所有能做的事都做完！你得再多玩玩！

lines.en: : I’ve had tons of fun with you. I just can’t stay here. There’s somewhere I need to get back to.
lines.zh: : 我跟你玩得很开心。只是我不能留在这儿。我有个地方必须回去。

lines.en: : Somewhere better than this?! Because nowhere is better than this! We have everything and more! And...And {i}I’m{/i} here!
lines.zh: : 比这里更好的地方？！因为没有什么地方比这里更好！我们什么都有，还更多！而且……而且{i}我{/i}就在这里！

lines.en: : Are you just going to keep me waiting again?! For how long?! When is the next time I’ll see you?! Will I {i}ever{/i} see you?! Am I just supposed to move on?!
lines.zh: : 你又要让我一直等下去吗？！要等到什么时候？！我下次见到你是什么时候？！我{i}还能{/i}再见到你吗？！我就该这么放下往前走吗？！

lines.en: : This world is for us! Not {i}me!{/i} This isn’t right! None of it is right!
lines.zh: : 这个世界是为我们而存在的！不是只为{i}我{/i}！这不对！这一切都不对！

lines.en: : Then...maybe I’ll find my way back somehow. I don’t know. But I didn’t mean to end up here today, so who’s to say the same thing won’t happen again?
lines.zh: : 那么……也许我总会想办法找回来的路。我不知道。不过我今天也不是故意走到这儿来的，所以谁说同样的事不会再发生一次呢？

lines.en: : Is that not a satisfying answer?
lines.zh: : 这个答案不满意吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think there can be a satisfying answer.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不可能有让人满意的答案。

lines.en: : I thought you’d want to stay after seeing how much there is to love here, but...
lines.zh: : 我以为你看到这里有这么多值得爱的东西之后，就会想留下来，可是……
: 看来还是不够。
: 而我大概……
: 大概{i}我{/i}也不够好……
: Akira……
: 如果……

lines.en: : If you’re not going to stay here...and live in the world that {i}I{/i} love...
lines.zh: : 如果你不肯留下来……不肯活在{i}我{/i}所爱的这个世界里……

lines.en: : Will you promise me you’ll do your best to love {i}yours?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你能不能答应我，你会尽力去爱{i}你的{/i}那个世界？

lines.en: : Because if...if I know you’re trying to be happy over there...
lines.zh: : 因为如果……如果我知道你在那边努力过得幸福……

lines.en: : I think I can try to be a little happier over here.
lines.zh: : 我想我也能试着在这边过得幸福一点点。
: 谢谢你……

lines.en: : And please...{i}please{/i} come visit me again. Even if it’s only for a little while.
lines.zh: : 还有求你了……{i}求你{/i}再来看我。哪怕只待一小会儿也好。

lines.en: : How about this...{i}you{/i} show me the way out and {i}I’ll{/i} try to come back as soon as possible. Does that work?
lines.zh: : 这样吧……{i}你{/i}给我指条出去的路，{i}我{/i}就尽快回来看你。这样行吗？

lines.en: : But there is no way out.
lines.zh: : 可是没有出去的路。

lines.en: : There has to be a way out.
lines.zh: : 一定有出去的路。

lines.en: : There really isn’t. All of the old exits are impossible to get through and you wouldn’t be able to survive outside anyway.
lines.zh: : 真的没有。所有旧的出口都过不去了，而且你在外面也活不下去。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to go {i}out{/i}side. I’m trying to go back to {i}my{/i} side.
lines.zh: : 我不是要{i}出{/i}去。我是要回到{i}我{/i}那一边去。

lines.en: : But I have no idea where that side {i}is.{/i} So how am I supposed to help you?
lines.zh: : 可我不知道那一边{i}在哪儿{/i}。那我要怎么帮你？

lines.en: : You really don’t know of {i}any{/i} way to leave the mall? Any at all?
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道有{i}什么{/i}离开商场的办法？一点都不知道？

lines.en: : Just those temporal rifts, but...I don’t want you to get covered in pee.
lines.zh: : 只有那些时空裂隙，不过……我不想让你被尿淋一身。
: 我也不想。
: 还有……那个洞？

lines.en: : You mean the one you didn’t push your ex-boyfriend into?
lines.zh: : 你是说你没把你前男友推进去的那个？

lines.en: : Right. The one I didn’t push my ex-boyfriend into.
lines.zh: : 对。就是我没把我前男友推进去的那个。
: 那也许——
: 说真的。不是我干的。

lines.en: : That might be our best course of action then.
lines.zh: : 那也许是我们最好的选择了。

lines.en: : How is falling for the rest of forever the best course of action?
lines.zh: : 永远往下掉怎么会是最好的选择？

lines.en: : Well...it could be like one of those dreams, right? Where you’re just falling and...then you wake up?
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许就像那种梦，对吧？你一直往下掉，然后……就醒了？

lines.en: : Sure. Or it could be like, you know, just literally falling. And then you don’t wake up. You just fall.
lines.zh: : 是啊。或者也可能就是，你知道的，真的往下掉。然后你没醒过来。你就一直掉。

lines.en: : Trust me. I’ve got a good feeling about this.
lines.zh: : 相信我。我对此有种好预感。

lines.en: : Well I sure as heck don’t, but...you know. Gender roles and all. I have to listen to you.
lines.zh: : 我可是一点好预感都没有，不过……你也知道。性别角色什么的。我得听你的。

lines.en: : Then please show me the way because there is absolutely no chance I’m getting there on my own.
lines.zh: : 那请给我带路吧，因为我绝对不可能自己找到那儿。

lines.en: : Heheh...yeah. This place takes a little getting used to, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……也是。这地方是需要点时间适应的，对吧？

lines.en: : To get to the abyss, we need to head back to 01110100.
lines.zh: : 要去那个深渊，我们得先回到 01110100。

lines.en: : I can take you there...I just have one more thing to ask in exchange for it.
lines.zh: : 我可以带你去……不过作为交换，我还有一件事想求你。
: 什么事？

lines.en: : That you hold my hand along the way...
lines.zh: : 一路上，请你牵着我的手……
: Amy，你没有手。
: 你说得对。
: 我完全忘了。

lines.en: : I guess just follow me then. It’s not like I can ask for a high five or anything either.
lines.zh: : 那你就跟着我走吧。反正我也没法跟你要个击掌什么的。
: 抱一下什么的也行？
: 求你别抱我

lines.en: : All that will do is make me even more upset that you’re leaving me behind.
lines.zh: : 那样只会让我因为你要丢下我而更加难过。

lines.en: : Akira...are you sure you want to do this? Because it still sounds really risky to me.
lines.zh: : Akira……你确定要做吗？因为在我听来这还是很冒险。

lines.en: : If it’s the only way for me to actually get out of this mall...yeah. I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 如果这是我真正走出这个商场的唯一办法……是的。我确定。

lines.en: : Okay, but...the room it’s in is kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不过……它所在的那个房间有点奇怪。

lines.en: : This whole place is kind of weird. I’m sure that whatever is in there won’t be much different.
lines.zh: : 这整地方都有点奇怪。我相信里面的东西也不会差太多。

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...okay. I’ll trust your judgement on this, I guess.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。我大概就相信你的判断了。

lines.en: : It’s through the second door on your right. But again, it’s weird.
lines.zh: : 从你右手边第二扇门进去。不过再说一次，那里很奇怪。
: 谢谢你，Amy。我很感——

lines.en: : You know, maybe getting covered in piss isn’t the worst-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许被尿淋一身也不是最糟的——
: {i}不是我干的！{/i}

lines.en: The voice of a new friend fades away as I descend.
lines.zh: 我向下坠落时，一个新朋友的声音渐渐远去。
: {size=-15}{i}说真的！不是我干的！{/i}{/size}

lines.en: : Sensei. Hey. Snap out of it.
lines.zh: : 老师。嘿。回神了。

lines.en: : What’s going on? I came here to buy new pajamas and the first thing I see is you just standing in the middle  of the mall with your eyes glossed over.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？我来买新睡衣，结果第一眼就看到你站在商场正中间，两眼发直。

lines.en: : Are you okay? Do you need me to take you home? Do you-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？要我送你回家吗？要——
: 我们回家吧。
